Q: Reverse columns of spreadsheet A:

use:

=CHOOSECOLS(A1:E1, 5,4,3,2,1)

or dynamically:

=LET(x, A1:E1, CHOOSECOLS(x, INDEX(-COLUMN(x))))

Q: SQS message not returned by ReceiveMessage even though message exists in queue A:

This happens because of how SQS works. Sometimes a message is “in flight” (already received but not deleted) and won’t show up until the visibility timeout expires.

Also, by default ReceiveMessage does short polling, so it can return empty even if messages exist. To fix this, use long polling with WaitTimeSeconds set to 10–20 seconds.

Make sure you delete messages only after processing, and check if any other consumers are reading from the queue — they could be taking messages first.

This usually explains why your API sometimes returns null even though the queue isn’t empty.

Q: Is it possible to install SQL Server Express edition side by side with SQL Server Developer edition? A:

Yes, you can install and run Microsoft SQL Server Express and the Developer Edition side by side on the same computer without any issues. The key requirement is to assign a unique instance name (e.g., SQLEXPRESS and SQLDEV) when installing the second instance and to configure different TCP ports to avoid conflicts.

Q: How to download a font used on a wesite on to my PC? A:

Sure enough, devtools inspect is the way to go here; Chromium-based have it at the bottom of the Styles pane, as you've shown, and Firefox has a dedicated pane for that, that can even highlight which individual characters are rendered in what font face (resolved, so even possible 'holes' where fallback happened), and some metadata from the files, without need to use external software.
